text:
incident-bot: Paging: p99 streaming latency spike detected for hosted API (route: /v1/stream). Alerts: +120% p99 over 10m, errors: proxy resets seen. Paging oncall: @sam (oncall)

sam (oncall): saw the page, taking it. any customer reports?

jules (support): one customer reported aborted streams around 11:12 UTC, says client saw ‘connection reset’ mid-response. ticket #CS-4821, affected multiple users in same org.

alex (eng-runtime): I'm getting logs for the streaming proxy now. early indication: large number of downstream FIN/RST from edge proxies during chunk flush. p95 fine, p99 jumps because long-tail chunking waits and then connection reset.

marta (eng-sre): tagging in. can you paste a short log snippet?

alex (eng-runtime): paste:```\n2025-07-02T11:11:58Z proxy-59 charlie: upstream write timeout after 30s while flushing chunk\n2025-07-02T11:12:03Z proxy-59 charlie: downstream FIN from 10.4.12.98, bytes_sent=1024\n2025-07-02T11:12:03Z proxy-59 charlie: connection closed during streaming call id=abc123\n```

marta (eng-sre): hmm looks like idle/reset on long-lived streams. what's our proxy idle timeout?

aleila (eng-platform): default edge idle timeout is 30s for idle write. We recently rolled a config change last week that tightened timeouts to reclaim sockets.

alex (eng-runtime): that lines up. The runtime flushes smaller chunks frequently; if client reads slow (backpressure) proxy sees no ACKs and triggers idle -> RST. p99 affected when clients are slow consumers. Also seeing some chunk coalescing delays on certain model responses.

sam (oncall): immediate mitigation options?

marta (eng-sre): short-term: increase edge idle write timeout to 90s for streaming routes, and enable keepalive/heartbeat chunk every 10s. That should prevent resets while we debug client backpressure patterns.

aleila (eng-platform): I can push a targeted config to the streaming route in prod in ~6m. will do a canary on 10% traffic first.

jules (support): can we notify impacted customers + provide mitigation steps (client side)?

nora (customer-success): yes, I'll draft a note: recommend client to enable streaming read buffer and exponential backoff on slow consumers. will coordinate once we confirm roll.

alex (eng-runtime): logging note: collection of slow consumer metrics is weak. I'll add an instrumentation flag to export per-connection read lag to internal metrics (low-risk).

marta (eng-sre): also capture p99/p999 per-route pre/post change to evaluate SLO breach scope. what are current SLOs?

sam (oncall): SLO: streaming p99 < 1.5s. we saw p99 ~ 6.2s at peak. counts: approx 3% of streaming sessions (by QPS) experienced >5s tail or reset.

aleila (eng-platform): canary config update pushed to edge-group-a (10%). observing metrics...

incident-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for config edge-timeout=90s, heartbeat=10s on route /v1/stream to edge-group-a

marta (eng-sre): metrics after 3m on canary: p99 down from 6.2s -> 1.4s for canary traffic. resets reduced by ~85% on canary. good sign.

sam (oncall): go ahead and ramp to 100% small steps, 50% now. monitor errors and connection counts.

aleila (eng-platform): ramping to 50% -> 100% now. finalizing config rollout.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete to 100% for edge-timeout=90s on /v1/stream

alex (eng-runtime): post-roll observations: proxy resets nearly gone, p99 back to 1.2s cluster-wide, p95 steady. we still see rare long-tails tied to very slow clients (mobile on flaky networks) but not SLO-breaching at scale.

jules (support): customer updates: CS-4821 notified and acknowledged the temporary mitigation. requesting root cause note and ETA for permanent fix.

marta (eng-sre): next steps for permanent fix: 1) add explicit streaming keepalive chunks in runtime, 2) improve client backpressure guidance in docs, 3) tune proxy metrics and make slow-consumer alert. I'll open tracking tasks.

alex (eng-runtime): I'll create a PR for keepalive chunking and light-weight read-lag metric. target in next sprint but will fast-track critical bits.

sam (oncall): handoff to next oncall @marta in 20m. leave runbook notes here: change rolled, observation window good, primary mitigation is edge timeout increase + heartbeat chunking config. monitor for regressions.

marta (eng-sre): ack taking over. creating incident channel and postmortem template. tagging owners: @alex for runtime fix, @aleila for platform config, @jules for customer comms.

nora (customer-success): also escalate to the affected customer with timeline and ask if they want more detailed logs.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated: SEV3 -> monitoring. Postmortem assigned: PM-6789.

sam (oncall): closing paging loop, handing to @marta for follow-up. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

marta (eng-sre): will draft RCA and include mitigations + timeline. leaving this thread for postmortem updates.

jules (support): adding CS ticket follow-ups to the incident doc.

alex (eng-runtime): note for postmortem: consider per-client backpressure budget and faster chunk flush for small responses.

marta (eng-sre): last note: no broad customer data loss, only aborted streams for a subset. impact window ~ 11:10-11:20 UTC. SLO breached for ~8 minutes.

nora (customer-success): copied. I'll close customer loop after RCA is published.
